title: Fire Alarm Manufacturer Classification Record
description: Classification record for a cropped fire alarm device image used in manufacturer, subtype, or model-family recognition tasks. This schema is intended for reviewed crops derived from approved or reviewable assets.

crop_id.description: Unique identifier for the crop record.

parent_image_id.description: Identifier of the parent scene image or rendered asset image.

asset_id.description: Optional identifier of the original source asset.

annotation_id.description: Optional source annotation identifier when the crop was derived from a detection annotation.

manufacturer.description: Reviewed manufacturer label. Unknown is allowed where branding is unreadable or unsupported.

device_type.description: Coarse public device type for the crop.

subtype.description: Optional richer internal subtype label such as smoke, heat, wall sounder, sounder-beacon, relay interface, or control module.

model.description: Optional product or model family label when available from approved material or verified review.

crop_path.description: Relative workspace path to the cropped image.

bbox.description: Source bounding box in the parent image as [x, y, width, height].

source_domain.description: Convenience provenance field for audit and split generation.

split.description: Dataset split assignment for the crop dataset.

ocr_text.description: OCR text detected inside or near the crop. Useful for OCR/logo fusion experiments.

logo_visible.description: True when branding or a manufacturer logo is visibly present in the crop.

reviewed.description: True when the crop label has been human-reviewed.

review_notes.description: Optional notes about ambiguity, unreadable branding, or class rationale.

metadata.description: Optional extra metadata kept open for future tooling.
